falsifiable_hypothesis: The PO-03 validator suite can run in a fresh checkout using only Python standard library dependencies.
pass_conditions: The source checkout has no tracked, untracked, or ignored state outside its immutable commit.
A no-local, no-hardlink clone checks out the exact requested commit in detached state.
The PO-03 tests pass under Python -I -S -B with an isolated HOME and TMPDIR.
The validator run leaves no tracked, untracked, or ignored state in the fresh clone.
Frozen untracked and ignored provider-state fixtures are rejected before clone execution.
fail_conditions: The source or child checkout contains hidden state.
The requested revision is not an immutable commit.
The isolated validator command exits nonzero or times out.
The validator creates undeclared checkout state.
